acceptanceCriteria: Decide and record in the Tasks spec whether renew counts as liveness (preferred: a successful renew updates lastHeartbeatAt), or amend renew --help and docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md to state that heartbeat is a separate obligation with its cadence.

A focused test covers a holder that renews within the liveness TTL without heartbeating: it must not be reported STALE_HOLDER if renew counts as liveness, or the help text test must cover the documented obligation otherwise.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 with corvint-tasks build 402 on queue:corvint:main. Attempt attempt:corvint:main:7f493eb294ec2725acb1a2f6f52e47b2 (V1-1305, holder claude-lane-V1-1305) was renewed by its orchestrator every 10 min (`corvint-tasks renew --attempt ID --generation G --request-id R --lease-minutes 180`, outcome OK at 16:45:52Z and 16:55:54Z, lease.expiresAt advanced to 19:55:53Z) yet the attempt record kept lastHeartbeatAt=16:22:53Z (the claim time) and a peer session claiming V1-1276 saw RESOURCE_COLLISION with the holder reported as STALE_HOLDER. Only `corvint-tasks attempt heartbeat` refreshes lastHeartbeatAt. Expected: a successful renew is a holder-issued write and proves liveness at least as strongly as a heartbeat, so either renew refreshes lastHeartbeatAt, or the STALE_HOLDER diagnosis also considers the most recent lease grant, or the renew usage/help says explicitly that heartbeat is a separate obligation. Actual: holders that renew but do not heartbeat look dead; `renew --help` does not mention heartbeat. Suspected defect, not confirmed against the V1-0625/V1-0882 holder-liveness contract; this question is to decide which of the three is the intended contract. Workaround in use: run attempt heartbeat beside each renew.
title: corvint-tasks: renew extends the lease but leaves lastHeartbeatAt stale, so a live renewing holder reads STALE_HOLDER to other claimants
